content: I want an angular plate with two quadratic plates positioned in right angel to each other. The edge length of the plates is 140mm. They are 10mm thick. On one of the two plates I would like to have a quadratic cutout, 45x45mm, centred on the plate. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the two plates

# Plate 1: Horizontal plate (along x-y plane)
plate1_x_size = 140  # mm
plate1_y_size = 140  # mm
plate1_z_size = 10   # mm
plate1_x = 0         # mm
plate1_y = 0         # mm
plate1_z = 0         # mm

# Plate 2: Vertical plate (along y-z plane)
plate2_x_size = 10   # mm
plate2_y_size = 140  # mm
plate2_z_size = 140  # mm
plate2_x = 0         # mm
plate2_y = 0         # mm
plate2_z = 0         # mm

# Cutout on Plate 1 (centered)
cutout_x_size = 45   # mm
cutout_y_size = 45   # mm
cutout_z_size = 10   # mm
cutout_x = (plate1_x_size - cutout_x_size) / 2  # mm
cutout_y = (plate1_y_size - cutout_y_size) / 2  # mm
cutout_z = 0         # mm

# Output the values
{
    "plate1": {
        "x_size": plate1_x_size,
        "y_size": plate1_y_size,
        "z_size": plate1_z_size,
        "x": plate1_x,
        "y": plate1_y,
        "z": plate1_z
    },
    "plate2": {
        "x_size": plate2_x_size,
        "y_size": plate2_y_size,
        "z_size": plate2_z_size,
        "x": plate2_x,
        "y": plate2_y,
        "z": plate2_z
    },
    "cutout": {
        "x_size": cutout_x_size,
        "y_size": cutout_y_size,
        "z_size": cutout_z_size,
        "x": cutout_x,
        "y": cutout_y,
        "z": cutout_z
    }
}"}
